text: S646 supplies the exact metadata-bearing R14 output to the already-authorized CLO receiver route once: nine named pieces and 13/18 exact CUT/SEW contours; the same five Polo CUTs fail at 0.001 cm, so CLO export was stopped. OpenCAD preserves the one-fixture metadata/geometry over two byte-identical R14 generations, but this generic profile is not an industrial apparel standard. The labeled 1:1 CLO overview is reviewed; all-seven, marks, grades, negative inputs, successful target round trip, and detailed readable output remain open. No criterion or hold changes. See E-G04-S646-EXIT.
